Staton, saw SolidCAM rolling out Copilot and the AI-driven manufacturing story heading into IMTS 2026, plus the DMG MORI partnership.

With Copilot and a new partnership driving demand, pipeline targets tend to climb faster than headcount can. Most leaders cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your North America team needs to cover this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
